title: I want Advice on Managing Projects in ERPNext

posts.cooked:
Hey everyone,

I have started exploring ERPNext for handling project management in my organization & I am still trying to figure out the best practices. I such as how ERPNext integrates tasks, timesheets & project costing into one platform but sometimes I feel I might not be using it to its full potential.

I am handling multiple client projects at the same time & I want to set up a process where the team can easily track progress, update tasks & also get clear reporting without too much manual work. I was also thinking about how it compares with other tools I have used in the past such as Jira. I did a short JIRA Training course some time back & found its workflow customization very flexible. Can ERPNext be set up to achieve something similar?

Want to hear how others here are using ERPNext for complex project setups & if you have tips for structuring tasks, roles & reports in a smarter way. Also i have check this What task can be performed in erpnext for project management of software company? still need advice.

Thank you.
